title: Distal agreement
reason: Highest ABC score among distal (>100 kb) positive pairs above 0.02; distance alone ranks this lower.

title: Strong score, no down call
reason: Highest ABC score among nonsignificant pairs above 0.02; a prediction–assay disagreement, not proof of no regulatory effect.

title: Nearby missed effect
reason: Nearest covered positive pair below the supplied 0.02 threshold; short distance can retain a useful candidate.

title: Coverage gap
reason: Lowest adjusted p-value among positive pairs with no matching saved prediction; zero is an evaluation fill, not a biological prediction.

title: Opposite effect direction
reason: Highest ABC score among significant increases; the benchmark target is down-regulation, not any expression change.
